groups.name: Sara Duterte Impeachment Outlook
groups.narrative: Lawmakers are debating whether the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte should continue even if she resigns.
groups.narrative_zh: 议员们正在辩论如果副总统萨拉·杜特尔特辞职，弹劾审判是否仍应继续进行。
groups.R_reason: The impeachment trial is a formal legal/parliamentary process with a binary outcome.
groups.S_reason: Official record of the House of Representatives/Senate.
groups.T_reason: The proceedings are ongoing but time-bound by legislative sessions.
groups.U_reason: The political maneuvering and decision to resign or proceed is highly volatile.
groups.H_reason: High-profile political issue involving national leaders.
groups.suggested_question: Will an impeachment trial of VP Sara Duterte be held by Dec 31, 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年12月31日前是否会对萨拉·杜特尔特副总统进行弹劾审判？

groups.name: Bato dela Rosa ICC Warrant
groups.narrative: Tensions rise as Bato dela Rosa faces legal scrutiny concerning the International Criminal Court (ICC) probe into the drug war.
groups.narrative_zh: 随着德拉罗萨面临涉及国际刑事法院（ICC）禁毒战争调查的法律审查，政治紧张局势加剧。
groups.R_reason: A warrant is either issued or it is not.
groups.S_reason: Court documents from the ICC or Philippine judicial bodies.
groups.T_reason: Depends on the timing of legal filings.
groups.U_reason: Uncertain whether the warrant will be enforced or issued under current political dynamics.
groups.H_reason: High sensitivity in Philippine political and legal circles.
groups.suggested_question: Will the ICC issue an arrest warrant for Bato dela Rosa in 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年国际刑事法院是否会对巴托·德拉罗萨签发逮捕令？

groups.name: Philippine Macroeconomic Stability
groups.name_zh: 菲律宾宏观经济稳定性
groups.narrative: The Philippine peso faces pressure amid broader regional emerging market instability and domestic political concerns.
groups.narrative_zh: 在更广泛的区域新兴市场动荡和国内政治担忧中，菲律宾比索面临压力。
groups.R_reason: Currency values are tracked by objective exchange rate data.
groups.S_reason: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) or Bloomberg data.
groups.U_reason: Global market fluctuations make predictions highly uncertain.
groups.suggested_question: Will the USD/PHP exchange rate exceed 60 by Q4 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年第四季度美元兑菲律宾比索汇率是否会超过60？

groups.name: Jinggoy Estrada Plunder Case
groups.narrative: The DOJ has made a recommendation regarding plunder charges against Jinggoy Estrada related to a flood control project scandal.
groups.narrative_zh: 司法部就与防洪项目丑闻有关的针对金戈伊·埃斯特拉达的腐败指控提出了建议。
groups.R_reason: Indictment is a clear legal milestone.
groups.U_reason: Legal outcome depends on evidence evaluation.
groups.suggested_question: Will Jinggoy Estrada be formally indicted for plunder by end of 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年底前金戈伊·埃斯特拉达是否会被正式以贪污罪起诉？

groups.name: Philippine Energy Grid Reliability
groups.narrative: Concerns regarding rotational blackouts in Luzon and Visayas have re-emerged as a critical infrastructure issue.
groups.narrative_zh: 对吕宋岛和米沙鄢群岛轮流停电的担忧再次浮出水面，成为关键的基础设施问题。
groups.R_reason: Grid status is tracked via official energy bulletins.
groups.U_reason: Dependent on power plant capacity and demand spikes.
groups.suggested_question: Will the DOE announce red alerts for the Luzon grid at least 5 times in 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年能源部是否会对吕宋电网发布至少5次红色警报？

groups.name: Cabinet Appointments and Instability
groups.narrative: Questions arise over the trust in Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla and the naming of a new DBM Secretary.
groups.narrative_zh: 人们对内政部长乔恩维克·雷穆拉的信任度以及新任预算与管理部长的任命提出疑问。
groups.R_reason: Appointments and confidence votes are formal acts.
groups.U_reason: Political appointments are often predictable once signaled.
groups.suggested_question: Will Jonvic Remulla remain Interior Secretary through the end of 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 乔恩维克·雷穆拉是否会留任内政部长至2026年底？
